about: What Opus answered when asked how each test character walks (baml run how_it_walks -- --dir runs/<run>, Nov 2026), kept so the walk tests give the same gait every time. The pipeline saves the same thing as gait.json in a run.

cave-troll.why: A top-heavy cave troll lumbering on short bowed legs, each flat foot slamming down. Its torso rocks side to side over the barrel belly, and its long arms swing low and heavy, almost to its knuckles. Its stony, hunched back stays stiff while its whole weight rolls forward.

shadow-ninja.why: He moves low on bent knees with quick, quiet rolling steps on soft soles, a little more planted than a slim ninja because of his sturdy build, with no show in his body and his shoulders loose.

stocky-pirate-deckhand.why: A thick-set deckhand rolls across the room on wide-set sea legs, landing heavily in his big boots and swinging his shoulders side to side, loose and sure of himself, with no care for who hears him.

lizardkin-warrior.why: A thick-set lizard soldier plods across the room on wide clawed feet with a planted, slightly side-to-side gait, its chest out and short tail swaying for balance, while the snug leather keeps its torso fairly firm.

young-lincoln-frontier-wrestler.why: A tall, gangly farm boy with a long, unhurried, loping stride, long arms swinging loose and big feet landing plainly, carrying a wrestler's easy, quiet confidence rather than any show.
